sections.heading: What can I order today?
sections.body: Only the currently available Opplex and Filex IPTV plans can be added to the cart. Ask about ChatGPT, Netflix, HBO Max and other OTT or AI plans on WhatsApp; confirm availability, country eligibility and terms before buying.

sections.heading: Can I pay for several plans together?
sections.body: The current checkout supports one plan at a time. Review the provider, subscription length and current total in the cart, then confirm the final details on Opplexify.

sections.heading: How many connections are included?
sections.body: Opplex has one simultaneous connection. The Filex allowance must be confirmed with support. Installed player apps and profiles do not create extra simultaneous connections.

sections.heading: Does Request pricing place an order?
sections.body: No. It opens WhatsApp with the selected product and plan so you can ask about current pricing and availability. You choose whether to send the message. Confirm the actual offer and terms before paying.

sections.heading: Is every OTT plan available in my country?
sections.body: Availability, plan names, household rules and device support can differ by country. Share your location and intended devices with support, then review the publisher’s official details before agreeing to a plan.

sections.heading: Does an AI chat subscription include API credits?
sections.body: Do not assume it does. Chat subscriptions and developer API usage can have separate accounts, limits and charges. Specify which service you need and confirm its billing before choosing an option.

buying-guide.title: A practical guide to choosing a digital plan
buying-guide.intro: A useful purchase starts with the details you can verify today, rather than a familiar product name. For OTT and AI plans, request pricing on WhatsApp and confirm your country, billing period and terms before purchasing.

sections.heading: Match the plan to your setup
sections.body: Identify your device and player, then compare Opplex and Filex as separate providers. Check the duration, current full price, connection allowance and any separate player licence. Ask support about anything unstated.

sections.heading: Review before paying
sections.body: The cart holds one plan. Current price and availability are checked again before checkout. Continue through the central Opplex website to Opplexify and review the final provider, term, currency and amount there.

sections.heading: Prepare an OTT pricing enquiry
sections.body: Include your country, preferred service and billing period in the enquiry. Check supported devices, simultaneous viewing and household rules against the official plan details. Confirm renewal, cancellation and account eligibility before agreeing to an offer; an enquiry card alone does not confirm that a plan can be supplied.

sections.heading: Separate AI subscriptions from API usage
sections.body: A chat subscription is not an API credit balance. State whether you need the consumer application or developer access, then confirm the account owner, usage limits, currency and renewal terms. Ask what is included rather than assuming that a higher tier provides unlimited use or every model.

sections.body: Indiquez pays, service souhaité et période de facturation. Vérifiez appareils, visionnage simultané et règles du foyer dans les détails officiels. Confirmez renouvellement, résiliation et éligibilité du compte avant d’accepter une offre ; une fiche de demande ne confirme pas à elle seule que la formule peut être fournie.

sections.heading: Distinguer abonnement IA et utilisation API
